versions.changelog: Remove shasum from metadata bins — no longer used in SKILL.md body after fingerprint/cache removal. Keeping mkdir and cp which are actually referenced.
Restore shasum and add cp to metadata bins. Scanner requires all commands used in SKILL.md body to be declared in metadata.

Remove fingerprint/cache mechanism and shasum dependency. Caching was over-engineered for A/B testing and triggered a misleading 'Crypto' capability signal on ClawHub. Each eval now runs independently for reliable results.
Add metadata.openclaw.requires.bins declaration for shasum and mkdir to match ClawHub security scan expectations.
Declare operational behaviors (subagent spawning, exec/shasum, file read/write) in description to address ClawHub suspicious scan.

Polish: improved description with pushy trigger language per skill-creator best practices, removed redundant When to Activate section (now in description), removed hardcoded DO NOT run constraint, compressed mode-specific reference from ~60 lines to ~12 lines, total SKILL.md now 374 lines.

Full rewrite: 10 eval modes (baseline, regression, model-swap, prompt-variant, trigger-accuracy, adversarial, script-test, hook-dryrun, cron-dryrun, integration). Self-contained — no external dependencies. LLM-as-Judge grading, fingerprint-based result caching, --dry preview and --smoke test, per-arm grading.json, benchmark.json report generation, and history.jsonl regression tracking.
Add example evals, remove empty dirs
Add example evals.json, remove empty dirs
Initial release: AB test eval framework for OpenClaw skills
